pages.target_query: NVIDIA H100 GPU Rental Rates & Hourly Price
pages.interconnect_faq: Choose H100 SXM5 (900 GB/s NVLink + NVSwitch, 3.35 TB/s HBM3) for multi-GPU 70B–405B distributed training, FSDP/DeepSpeed ZeRO-3, or tensor-parallel FP8 serving where all-reduce communication dominates step time. Choose H100 PCIe Gen5 (128 GB/s bidirectional, 2.0 TB/s HBM2e/HBM3) for single-GPU vLLM inference, LoRA/QLoRA fine-tuning, and batch embeddings at 15%–30% lower hourly rental rates.

pages.target_query: NVIDIA H200 141GB Cloud Rental Rates & Hourly Price
pages.interconnect_faq: NVIDIA H200 SXM5 pairs 141 GB of HBM3e memory at 4.8 TB/s bandwidth (1.43x H100 bandwidth, 1.76x VRAM) with 900 GB/s NVLink. Rent 4x or 8x H200 SXM5 nodes when serving 70B–120B FP8/BF16 models with long KV-cache contexts (64K–128K tokens) or fitting larger micro-batches without activation checkpointing overhead.

pages.target_query: NVIDIA B200 192GB Blackwell Cloud Rental Rates
pages.interconnect_faq: NVIDIA B200 SXM6 delivers 192 GB HBM3e (8.0 TB/s) and 5th-Gen NVLink (1.8 TB/s per GPU) with native 2nd-Gen Transformer Engine FP4/FP8 support. Select 8x B200 SXM6 NVSwitch clusters for frontier pre-training, MoE routing, and high-throughput FP4 reasoning inference where per-token cost beats Hopper despite higher hourly node rates.

pages.target_query: NVIDIA A100 GPU Rental Rates (80GB & 40GB Hourly Pricing)
pages.interconnect_faq: A100 80GB SXM4 provides 2.0 TB/s HBM2e and 600 GB/s NVLink, making it a cost-efficient workhorse for 13B–70B BF16 fine-tuning and multi-GPU PyTorch jobs when Hopper/Blackwell FP8 is unnecessary. A100 40GB (1.55 TB/s HBM2) and PCIe Gen4 variants suit 7B–14B inference, classic CV/audio training, and CI evaluation pipelines.

pages.target_query: RTX 5090 & RTX 4090 Cloud GPU Rental Rates
pages.ref_label: Managed Workstation Cloud GPU List Benchmark
pages.interconnect_faq: RTX 5090 (32 GB GDDR7, 1.79 TB/s, PCIe Gen5) and RTX 4090 (24 GB GDDR6X, 1.01 TB/s, PCIe Gen4) omit NVLink/P2P high-speed fabric, so multi-GPU all-reduce traverses host PCIe. Use 1x–4x RTX 5090/4090 instances for quantized LLM inference (AWQ/GGUF/FP8), diffusion/video rendering, LoRA adapters, and embarrassedly parallel batch workers.

pages.target_query: NVIDIA B300 288GB Blackwell Ultra Cloud Rental Rates
pages.interconnect_faq: NVIDIA B300 (Blackwell Ultra) expands per-GPU HBM3e capacity to 288 GB (2.3 TB across an 8x SXM6 node) with 1.8 TB/s NVLink 5 and enhanced dense FP4 compute. Rent 8x B300 SXM6 nodes when 405B–1T+ parameter Mixture-of-Experts models or million-token KV caches must reside inside a single high-bandwidth NVSwitch domain.

pages.target_query: NVIDIA L40S 48GB Cloud GPU Rental Rates & Hourly Pricing
pages.ref_label: AWS EC2 g6e / Standard Hyperscaler L40S List
pages.interconnect_faq: NVIDIA L40S (48 GB GDDR6 ECC, Ada Lovelace FP8 Transformer Engine) omits NVLink, making PCIe Gen4 single-GPU and 2x–4x data-parallel inference, multimodal serving, and Omniverse/3D rendering 40%–60% cheaper per hour than H100 when HBM3 bandwidth is not the bottleneck.

pages.target_query: NVIDIA RTX A6000 & 6000 Ada 48GB Cloud GPU Rental Rates
pages.interconnect_faq: RTX A6000 (48 GB Ampere) and RTX 6000 Ada (48 GB Ada Lovelace) provide generous 48 GB VRAM per PCIe slot—ideal for 32B–70B quantized vLLM/Ollama serving, LoRA fine-tuning, and Diffusion pipelines that exceed 24 GB consumer cards without paying H100 SXM5 rates.
